title: When Does Jacobian Fine-Tuning Stabilize Neural PDE Emulators?
abstract: arXiv:2610.42013v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural emulators of chaotic PDEs are trained on one-step prediction but deployed autoregressively, where their errors compound. Jacobian-based regularisers aim to curb this growth, but in a chaotic system part of the growth is physical and cannot be trained away. We separate the two sources of this error with a first-order decomposition. We compare the emulator's error with a counterfactual that propagates the same one-step mistakes through the solver's Jacobian, giving an amplification ratio: the factor by which the model's own dynamics amplify its errors. We study 21 configurations across four PDEs, five architectures and two model sizes (8-10k and 33k parameters), with errors measured at one Lyapunov time. Jacobian fine-tuning reduced the error by more than 10% for 1 of 34 seeds whose amplification ratio was at most 1.25, and for all 20 seeds whose ratio was at least four; for the latter, the error fell by a factor of 8 (small models)

translated_title: 雅可比微调何时能稳定神经PDE仿真器？
translated_abstract: 混沌偏微分方程（PDE）的神经仿真器在训练时只做单步预测，但部署时以自回归方式运行，误差会不断累积。基于雅可比矩阵的正则化方法旨在抑制这种误差增长，但在混沌系统中，部分增长是物理固有的，无法通过训练消除。我们通过一阶分解将这两种误差来源分离开来：将神经仿真器的误差与一个反事实进行比较——该反事实通过求解器的雅可比矩阵传播相同的单步误差——从而得到一个放大比率，即模型自身动力学放大其误差的倍数。我们研究了21种配置，涵盖四个PDE、五种架构和两种模型规模（8-10k和33k参数），误差在一个李雅普诺夫时间处测量。结果表明：对于放大比率不超过1.25的34个随机种子，雅可比微调仅使其中1个种子的误差降低超过10%；而对于放大比率至少为4的20个种子，误差均显著下降，其中小模型的误差降低了8倍。
tldr: 该论文提出一阶分解方法与“放大比率”指标，将神经PDE仿真器的误差区分为可训练的模型误差与物理固有的混沌增长，并发现雅可比微调仅在放大比率较高（≥4）时才有效（误差最多降低8倍），在放大比率较低（≤1.25）时几乎无效。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a first-order decomposition with an "amplification ratio" metric to separate trainable model error from physical chaotic growth in neural PDE emulators, showing that Jacobian fine-tuning is effective (reducing error up to 8×) only when the amplification ratio is high (≥4), and largely ineffective when it is low (≤1.25).
